chunks: If they come to believe as you did, they will find the right path. If they turn away then they will only oppose; but God will suffice you against them, for God hears all and knows everything.

key_terms.سَيَكْفِيَهُمُ اللَّهُ: God will suffice you against them

ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'God will suffice you against them' in Surah Al-Baqarah?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as a divine promise of sufficiency (kifayah) for the faithful against their adversaries, particularly highlighting the transition from the era of the Prophet to the Imamate. It underscores that true guidance requires adherence to the same core truth accepted by the community, while persistent rejection leads to divine protection and ultimate victory for the believers.
